caption: The drawing depicts a single long smoking pipe placed horizontally across a plain, off-white background. The pipe has a light red-brown bowl on the left side, which is rounded and curves upward, and the stem extends to the right as a straight elongated tube. The stem is colored light tan and has joint-like segments suggesting a bamboo or reed material. The shading on the bowl and stem indicates a cylindrical form. Near the right side of the drawing, below the pipe, there is a small handwritten label that reads "Indian Tobacco pipe" in cursive. There are no other objects, decorative elements, or distinct background features visible in the drawing.
title: Shaker Clay Pipe
